propositions: The applier re-attempts the same structurally-impossible Jira-to-rebar link ADDs on every reconcile pass because failed links never land LINK events and are re-emitted identically by the differ, causing permanent WARNING noise and zero convergence.

Three error shapes (closed source, redundant ancestry, cycle) are deterministic verdicts from local graph state that will never succeed until the local structure changes, but are currently only warn-and-continue with no durable memory of the failure.

The fix records permanently impossible link ADDs durably with a deciding digest over the structural inputs that determined the failure, skipping re-attempts until that digest changes; separate state file committed to tickets branch survives process restarts.

Cycle detection walks the transitive graph so intermediate ticket changes break cycles even if endpoints are unchanged; the digest must cover the global structural projection to correctly invalidate cycle records without under-suppressing.

Endpoint promotion via resolve_hierarchy_link can redirect a link target to a type-tier ancestor before validation; the fingerprint must cover the full parent chain to catch the redirect target without drifting from promotion rules.
